policies.name: Report visible content
policies.with_check:
((reporter_id = auth.uid()) AND ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM posts
  WHERE (posts.id = content_reports.post_id))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM missions
  WHERE (missions.id = content_reports.mission_id)))))

policies.name: Private applications
policies.using:
((applicant_id = auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM missions
  WHERE ((missions.id = mission_applications.mission_id) AND (missions.author_id = auth.uid())))))

policies.name: Organizer finalists
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM missions m
  WHERE ((m.id = mission_finalists.mission_id) AND (m.author_id = auth.uid()))))

policies.name: Interest participants
policies.using:
((applicant_id = auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM posts p
  WHERE ((p.id = post_collaboration_interests.post_id) AND (p.author_id = auth.uid())))))

policies.name: Visible conversation
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM posts p
  WHERE ((p.id = post_comments.post_id) AND (NOT p.hidden))))

policies.name: Visible reaction totals
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM posts p
  WHERE ((p.id = post_reactions.post_id) AND (NOT p.hidden))))

policies.name: Save visible posts
policies.with_check:
((user_id = auth.uid()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM posts
  WHERE (posts.id = post_saves.post_id))))

policies.name: Read visible showcase images
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM showcase_items s
  WHERE (s.id = showcase_images.item_id)))

policies.name: Read available showcases or own management
policies.using: ((owner_id = auth.uid()) OR community_is_admin() OR ((status = 'published'::text) AND available AND (NOT hidden) AND showcase_owner_visible(owner_id)))

policies.name: Save published showcases
policies.with_check:
((user_id = auth.uid()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM showcase_items s
  WHERE ((s.id = showcase_saves.item_id) AND (s.status = 'published'::text) AND s.available AND (NOT s.hidden)))))

policies.name: Live stories
policies.using: ((deleted_at IS NULL) AND (expires_at > now()) AND ((NOT hidden) OR community_is_admin()) AND showcase_owner_visible(author_id))

policies.name: Delete own unused mission images
policies.using:
((bucket_id = 'mission-images'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] = (auth.uid())::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM missions m
  WHERE (m.image_path = objects.name)))) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM mission_drafts d
  WHERE ((d.published_at IS NULL) AND ((d.data ->> 'image_path'::text) = objects.name))))))

policies.name: Delete own unused post images
policies.using:
((bucket_id = 'post-images'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] = (auth.uid())::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM posts p
  WHERE (p.image_path = objects.name)))))

policies.name: Delete unused showcase photos
policies.using:
((bucket_id = 'showcase-media'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] = (auth.uid())::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM showcase_images i
  WHERE (i.path = objects.name)))))

policies.name: Delete unused story image
policies.using:
((bucket_id = 'story-images'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] = (auth.uid())::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM stories s
  WHERE (s.image_path = objects.name)))))

policies.name: Read attached showcase photos
policies.using:
((bucket_id = 'showcase-media'::text) AND (((storage.foldername(name))[1] = (auth.uid())::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM showcase_images i
  WHERE (i.path = objects.name)))))

policies.name: Read visible mission images
policies.using:
((bucket_id = 'mission-images'::text) AND (((storage.foldername(name))[1] = (auth.uid())::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM missions m
  WHERE (m.image_path = objects.name)))))

policies.name: Read visible post images
policies.using:
((bucket_id = 'post-images'::text) AND (((storage.foldername(name))[1] = (auth.uid())::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM posts p
  WHERE (p.image_path = objects.name)))))
